Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

mintyrasr 0.4.0

Cross-validation without a reliability filter

  • cv_min_rel = -Inf (new, default): validation individuals are not filtered by reliability. They have no own record in the training set, so a low reliability is expected; a filter kept only well-connected individuals, biased PA and shrank the sample. min_rel (default 0.05) now applies to the final GEBVs of the full-data fit.
  • New output gebv: GEBV, PEV, F, reliability and reliable = rel >= min_rel for every individual of each full-data fit (keep_gebv = TRUE). Tables over Excel’s row limit are written to <path>_<name>.csv.
  • neg_to_na now defaults to FALSE: dropping negative PA / slopes biased the mean upwards. neg_to_na = TRUE gives the old behaviour.

Long runs

  • Progress: one line per fit with status, iterations, time and estimated time left; a summary line at the end. ASReml’s iteration monitor is off while mintyrasr runs (asreml_trace = TRUE to keep it).
  • max_update now defaults to 2: a fit that has not converged is continued with update(); the number used is in param$updates / accuracy$cv_updates.
  • nonconv = "skip" (default): a parameter fit that still has not converged is reported with status = "not_converged" and its CV rows are skipped; a CV fit gives NA for its fold. nonconv = "keep" uses such fits.
  • Safe running: errors, non-convergence, boundary estimates and invalid LRTs are recorded in the new $log (time, stage, label, type, message) instead of interrupting the loop; one warning at the end. param and accuracy gain status; summary uses only rows with status == "ok".

mintyrasr 0.3.2

From the second validation run with ASReml-R 4.2.0.481:

  • An LRT where both models have the same number of free parameters (df = 0, e.g. a covariance restrained at a bound) gives rg_p = NA with a warning, instead of a misleading p = 0.
  • New min_n = 10: a fold needs at least min_n validation individuals with a usable GEBV (after min_rel) for PA, accuracy and slope. With a low h2 the reliability filter could leave 2-7 animals and PA / slope were noise.
  • cv_iter is documented as the length of the iteration history (2 for fixed variances).
  • Confirmed on real ASReml-R: rg_p equals lrt(full, idh, boundary = FALSE); fixed-variance CV fits give no warnings; cv_vc = "warm" needs about half the iterations of "estimate" and gives the same results.

mintyrasr 0.3.1

Fixes found by running the validation script with ASReml-R 4.2.0.481:

  • The LRT of rg = 0 (and test_rp) uses lrt(), the name in ASReml-R 4.2, with a fallback to lrt.asreml() for older releases. Before, the call failed silently and rg_p was always NA. LRT failures now give a warning.
  • Fixed-variance CV fits (cv_vc = "fixed", maxit = 1) no longer pass on ASReml’s expected “Log-likelihood not converged” warnings.
  • accuracy gains cv_converge and cv_iter (iterations of each fold’s fit).
  • Confirmed on real ASReml-R: component names for idv, us, idh/diag, corgh, corh and corv, vparameters order, coefficient names, and h2 / rg / rp / repeatability identical to hand-written vpredict() formulas.

mintyrasr 0.3.0

  • traits = names the response column(s) when the nested data do not use value / value1 + value2 (e.g. traits = c("bfs", "nls")).
  • asr_scenarios() runs the mt_bt scenario of cv_scenarios() (one trait treated as a different trait in each of two groups), with a diag residual and without rp.
  • test_rp = TRUE: joint LRT of all covariances = 0. rp = FALSE drops the phenotypic correlation.
  • corgh correlation rows such as ...!trait!b:!trait!a.cor are recognised.

mintyrasr 0.2.1

  • V numbers follow fit$vparameters, the order used by vpredict().
  • Warning when ginv has no INVERSE = TRUE attribute, when components are fixed at the boundary (B, also in param$boundary) and when asreml.options(gammaPar = TRUE).
  • New structure corv.

mintyrasr 0.2.0

  • LRT of rg = 0 uses idh(trait) and boundary = FALSE.
  • New columns: pa = r(y, GEBV) (the former accuracy), accuracy = pa / sqrt(h2) with the full-data h2, va, h2_full.
  • cv_vc = "fixed" (maxit = 1), "warm" or "estimate".
  • genetic_cov, random_cov: us, idh / diag, corh, corgh; random = ~ ide(id) etc.; na_x; asreml_args.

mintyrasr 0.1.1

  • h2, rg and rp are built from the names of the variance components instead of fixed V1, V2, … positions; vc_index table; vpredict = for your own formulas; random =, random_cov, residual_cov.

mintyrasr 0.1.0

  • First version: asr_gblup() and asr_scenarios().
